Open Day - Tour Dates 2025
At Beauclerc and Chennestone we believe it is important for you to experience first-hand the rich and vibrant learning environments we have created for our children.
We take great pride in the education we provide and the opportunities we offer our pupils. Our dedicated teachers and staff work tirelessly to ensure that every child feels engaged and inspired to learn. We genuinely believe that visiting our school will give you a true insight into the positive atmosphere and ethos that defines our community.
We warmly invite you and your child to join us for a tour! During your visit, you will have the chance to explore our facilities, learn about our curriculum, and see our wonderfully engaged children in action. It is a fantastic opportunity for you to ask questions and discover how we support each child's educational journey.
We recommend that you bring along any family members who are also interested in our school. Tours will be scheduled throughout the year and commence in September. Please do let us know if you would like to attend by contacting our school office on info@chennestone.surrey.sch.uk.
We are looking forward to welcoming you and showing you everything that makes our school special. Thank you for your continued support and involvement in our school community.
Please visit our website: Tours

SEND
Mr Willoughby is our Inclusion Lead and
Special Needs Coordinator (SENCo)
Special Educational Needs and Disability (SEND)
Many children, at some time in their school career will have additional needs of some kind, whether in terms of learning, communication and interaction, physical and sensory, or social and emotional needs.
At Beauclerc, we are ambitious and hold high expectations for all of our children. We recognise adaptations are required for some children to achieve progress within the curriculum. High Quality Teaching allows for curriculum adaptations to be made with all children working on the same skills and towards the same end point.
A few children will need help and support for all of their time at school, whilst others will benefit from support for a shorter time. Most additional needs are met by an adapted provision within the classroom. Additional, and more personalised provision, is made through a variety of evidence-based interventions.
All teachers at Beauclerc, are teachers of SEND and all staff working with children with SEND hold the same high ambitions and the knowledge to deliver adaptive teaching to the skill. All staff are responsive and adaptive to what children can do.
Our ambition is holistic and we recognise the key influences that interactively affect children’s learning and development. Through our well designed curriculum and adaptive teaching approach, we support more complex everyday activities and interactions with each child’s immediate environment.
Adaptations may include but are not limited to:
Our SEND Information Report details the types of support that are offered at Beauclerc. Underpinning all decisions about support is the wish that children leaving us in year 2 are as self-reliant and independent as possible.
Appointments to speak with our Inclusion Lead and SENCO, Mr Willoughby, can be made through the school office - 01932 780672.

Late/Absence Procedures
Beauclerc Infant and Nursery School welcomes children into the playground at 8:30am when the school gates open. The gate then closes at 8:45am when the register is taken. Please do ensure that your child is at school on time as there are valuable learning opportunities set for before and during register time. If your child is late, please come to the front office where they will be signed in. Please remember that lateness is classed as an absence and will affect your child's attendance. The school office will call if your child is absent without a reason.
If your child is ill and will be absent from school, please contact the school office on 01932 780672. If you phone before 8.30am, you will be able to leave a message which a member of the office staff will pick up. Alternatively, the office is manned from 8.30am onwards and you will be able to speak to a member of office staff. We do ask that you phone on each day of your child's absence so that we can keep our school registers updated.
Schools are unable to authorise any holidays during term time. If children are absent from school for a holiday during term time parents will face a Penalty Notice.
On the rare occasion where children may need to be absent from school for another reason, there is form attached below to make a "Request for an Exceptional Leave of Absence". This will need to be submitted to the Headteacher with plenty of notice.

Our Curriculum
During your child's time at Beauclerc Infant and Nursrey school they will experience a broad and exciting curriculum, which we hope will help develop in them a love of learning and the skills and values to help them become life long learners. We strive to help children become active and socially aware citizens so they can take full advantage of the opportunities available to them as they continue to the next phase of their education and in their future careers. We believe that all children can succeed in their learning and this is the basis of our motto: “Learning to Succeed, Succeeding to Learn.”

Wraparound Care
Beauclerc and Chennestone
Wraparound Child Care
At Beauclerc and Chennestone, we recognise the challenges that many families face in balancing work commitments with childcare needs. To support our community, we are pleased to offer wraparound care services both in the morning before school and after school throughout the year.
Premier Education provides our wraparound care service, which includes both Breakfast and After School Club sessions. These sessions are designed to ensure that your children are well cared for in a safe and engaging environment, allowing you to manage your work commitments with greater ease
The Breakfast Club opens at 7:45AM, providing a nutritious start to the day with a variety of breakfast options available. This service not only allows children to enjoy a healthy meal but also offers them the opportunity to socialise and participate in fun activities before the school day begins.
Our After School Club runs until 6:00 PM, offering a range of engaging activities that cater to the interests and needs of our children. From arts and crafts to sports and games, the After School Club provides a stimulating environment where children can unwind and continue learning in a relaxed setting.
Breakfast Club: 7:45am – 8:30am
After School Club: 3:15pm – 6:00pm
Breakfast Club: £7.00 per session (includes breakfast)
After School Club: £15.00 per session (includes tea time snack) Please note there is an additional £5 charge for same-day bookings.
The wraparound care is based at Chennestone Primary School and is open to children from both Chennestone and Beauclerc Infant and Nursery School. Those from Beauclerc will benefit from a ‘walking bus’ service, escorted by staff, ensuring a safe and enjoyable journey to and from Chennestone.
Club Manager & Safety Max Benincasa is our club manager. All staff have enhanced DBS clearance, up-to-date Paediatric First Aid, and Child Safeguarding qualifications. In light of Covid-19, all Premier staff have also completed the Transcend L2 Award in Infection Control, Mitigation, and Management.
From Max: "Here at wraparound care, children enjoy a range of exciting and stimulating activities, including biscuit decorating, board games, arts and crafts, football and special events! We also make great use of the outdoor space, with sports activities when the weather permits.
At Breakfast Club, children can choose between cereal or a continental breakfast, while at After School Club we offer a weekly nutritious menu—bagels, pittas, wraps, or toasties with vegetable sticks—which the children help prepare, supporting the development of life skills.
Our priority is to create a fun and safe environment where children are happy, engaged, and enjoying their time before and after school."
Sessions can be booked in advance or on an ad hoc basis to suit your childcare needs.
Breakfast Club: https://family.premier-education.com/add-course/943568
After School Club: https://family.premier-education.com/add-course/943569
For more information, please visit www.premier-education.com

Cookies
Some cookies are necessary in order to make this website function correctly. These are set by default and whilst you can block or delete them by changing your browser settings, some functionality such as being able to log in to the website will not work if you do this. The necessary cookies set on this website are as follows:
Website CMS
A 'sessionid' token is required for logging in to the website and a 'crfstoken' token is used to prevent cross site request forgery. An 'alertDismissed' token is used to prevent certain alerts from re-appearing if they have been dismissed. An 'awsUploads' object is used to facilitate file uploads.
Matomo
We use Matomo cookies to improve the website performance by capturing information such as browser and device types. The data from this cookie is anonymised.
reCaptcha
Cookies are used to help distinguish between humans and bots on contact forms on this website.
Cookie notice
A cookie is used to store your cookie preferences for this website.
